text:
Maya: Heads up — Eden adapter merge went in for cust-eden. Quick smoke needed: int4 quant + tokenizer remap looks suspicious on numeric fields.
Sam: Got it. Reproduced a small repro where amounts turn into weird tokens. :thinking_face: 
Maya: Example prompt: "Invoice total: $" -> model outputs "Invoice total: $ 0000" sometimes. Not consistent.
Jo: Can you paste the quant config you used? I want to run the eval pack and check rollouts.
Maya: Config snippet:
```
quant: int4
per_channel: true
symmetry: false
calib_samples: 512
```
Ria: I'll run the quick-eval pack (sanity + numeric-preservation). Which dataset split? small customer invoices or synthetic?
Maya: Start with cust-eden/invoices-small (sanitized) then synthetic edgecases.
Ken: Infra note — leader node picked int4 kernels on A100. If we see tokenization mismatch it could be tokenizer -> vocab remap + kv-cache stride interaction.
Sam: I tried forcing `use_kv_offset=False` and the failure rate dropped 60% in the small batch.
Jo: Nice find. Can you run a 200-sample smoke with and without kv-offset and post top-3 diffs?
Sam: On it. Patching the eval script, will push results to the thread in ~20m.
Maya: Also want a canary rollout plan: start with 5% traffic on Dedicated, monitor invoice-amount precision metric + hallucination rate.
Jo: Agreed. Add fallback to FP16 model when hallucination rate > 0.5% for 5m.
Ken: I'll create a canary job: `eden-quant-canary-2026-03-22` with metrics hooks to console.
Ria: Quick tests done locally: int4 + kv_offset=True -> 7/100 noisy; int4 + kv_offset=False -> 2/100 noisy. Attaching CSV to the eval pack results.
Sam: Results uploaded: s3://redwood-eval/eden/int4-kv-offset-comparison/4887654321.csv :thumbsup: 
Maya: Thanks. Next steps: Jo to run full quick-eval pack; Ken to stage canary; Sam to add kv-offset toggle to runtime feature flag; Ria to add numeric-preservation checks to regression suite.
Jo: I'll kick off eval now and tag the results when done. @Ken can you provision a 5% canary slot for the job?
Ken: Yep, provisioning. ETA ~30m.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment eden-quant-canary-2026-03-22 scheduled by Ken at 4887654380.
Maya: Great. If eval shows >0.5% regression we block and fallback. Keep updates here. :rocket:
